_meta.calibration_note: The skill's channel CAC benchmarks are USD/Western-calibrated. India-specific CPI anchors used instead where found: Linkrunner 'State of Mobile App Growth India 2026' (vendor sample of 58 paid apps): median India CPI ~INR 20.19, EdTech ~INR 67.79, 87.5% of installs Android. Organic 'effective CAC' = founder time valued at an assumed INR 500/hour (estimate) divided by estimated installs. All install-yield figures are ESTIMATES.

ltv_assumptions: Subscription ARPU = INR 199/yr Pro (INR 16.6/mo) x 0.8% freemium conversion = INR 0.13 per user per month (pricing.json)

Ad ARPU ~INR 1.0 per active user per month (ESTIMATE: ~25 ad impressions/month at ~INR 40 eCPM; India eCPMs are low and the head keyword CPC is ~$0.01). Ads conflict with the trust/quiet positioning — any reduction lowers LTV further
Lifespan 4 months: retention.json D30 = 8% -> framework band 3-6 months; midpoint-low chosen because churn_risk = high
Sanity check: RevenueCat-cited median revenue per install at 60 days for India/SEA subscription apps ~$0.11 (~INR 10); our ~$0.05 per user is plausible for a free-core utility
Confidence medium (not high): pricing.json + retention.json exist, but both conversion and retention are estimates, and user_profile.md is missing

founder_budget_tier_rationale: No memory/user_profile.md. Solo indie Android developer, builder tier, no audience, budget unknown -> assumed Bootstrap ($0-100/mo, ~INR 0-8,800). Paid channels excluded from the recommendation per skill rules.

aso_organic.assumption: 20 founder-hrs/mo (INR 10,000) on Hindi/state long-tail listing experiments -> ~1,000 installs/mo after ramp (estimate); saturated category adjusts upward

content_seo.assumption: Long-tail eligibility pages; head terms KD 100; 3-6 month lag

tiktok_organic.assumption: TikTok is banned in India; modelled as YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels made by the founder. No visual hook; incumbents' creators dominate

reddit_community.assumption: Reddit is irrelevant for this audience; modelled as Telegram/WhatsApp aspirant-group seeding with share cards: 15 hrs/mo (INR 7,500) -> ~1,900 installs/mo (estimate); admins may ban promotion

paid_social_meta.assumption: Between India median CPI INR 20 and EdTech INR 68 (Linkrunner); skipped for recommendation (Bootstrap)

paid_social_tiktok.assumption: TikTok banned in India. Closest analogue, Google App Campaigns, estimated INR 30/install -> LTV:CAC 0.15 (cash burn)

influencer.assumption: Micro govt-exam YouTubers/coaching channels; creators are competitors with their own apps; creator fit low

word_of_mouth.assumption: Share-card build cost amortized; k ~0.12 means volume is only ~12% on top of other channels — not a standalone channel. Effective-CAC viral multiplier 1/(1-k) = 1.14 already reflected

press_product_hunt.assumption: Product Hunt audience is not Indian sarkari aspirants; Indian vernacular press possible but one-off

skipped_channels: press_product_hunt (utility app, wrong audience; one-time cohort ~200 at most)
paid_social_meta and influencer excluded from recommendation (Bootstrap tier) but still modelled for completeness
recommended_first_channel: Telegram/WhatsApp aspirant-group seeding with shareable eligibility cards (best ratio at 1.13:1 among executable channels), paired with Hindi long-tail ASO
recommended_first_channel_rationale: Highest LTV:CAC among channels a Bootstrap-tier solo builder can execute without cash. Even so it is below 2:1 — it is recommended only as the vehicle for the RAT experiment, not as a growth plan.
market_insights_adjustments: trend_velocity = stable: no organic tailwind adjustment
monetization_evidence shows incumbents (Testbook, Adda247) heavily funded and running YouTube/Telegram/SEO funnels -> organic channel CACs adjusted upward
web-search: head keyword CPC ~$0.01 -> ad-yield assumption kept very low
apps: India revenue per download ~$0.03 (TechCrunch/Sensor Tower) and India/SEA download-to-paid 0.7-1.4% (RevenueCat-cited) -> conversion kept at 0.8%
viability_verdict_rationale: No channel reaches 2:1 except volume-capped word of mouth. Root cause is LTV, not CAC: ~INR 4.5 (~$0.05) lifetime revenue per user because the core value (alerts) must be free and ad yields on this intent are near zero. Break-even math: to hit 3:1 on ASO (INR 10 CAC) LTV must reach ~INR 30, i.e., ~6.7x today — achievable only by monetizing a different job (e.g., INR 29-49 per assisted application at even 5-10% of users per exam cycle) or by B2B licensing. user_profile.md missing — budget tier assumed.
